onsets.description: Consonants or consonant clusters that start a syllable, lowercase a to z, 1 to 3 letters each (k, th, str, mb).

vowels.description: Vowels or vowel clusters at the heart of a syllable, letters a e i o u y only, 1 to 3 letters each (a, ou, ii).

codas.description: Consonants or clusters a name may end on, 1 to 3 letters each (n, sh, rk). May be empty for a tongue of open syllables.

closed.description: Percent of names that end on a coda, 0 to 80.

long.description: Percent of given names with two syllables rather than one, 0 to 90.
